title_en: Official Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Applying to the People's Court for Enforcement of Specific Administrative Acts Made by Forestry Administrative Organs According to Law

articles.content_en:
Ministry of Forestry:
Your letter Lin Han Ce Zi (1993) No. 308 has been received. Upon study, the opinions proposed by your ministry are agreed, namely: where a natural person, legal person, or unincorporated organization neither initiates prosecution nor performs a specific administrative act lawfully made by the forestry competent authority within the statutory time limit, the forestry competent authority may, pursuant to Article 97 of the Administrative Procedure Law, apply to the People's Court for compulsory execution, and the People's Court shall accept such application.
